themeDescription: Rider lost, gate security denial & wrong apartment

challenges.title: Delivery partner stopped by society security guard without entry OTP
challenges.shortDescription: Coordinate between a confused delivery rider and a customer whose gated society requires MyGate security clearance.
challenges.mission: Explain the society gate barrier calmly, obtain digital approval or entry code, and guide rider directly to tower elevator.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Why has my rider been standing outside Tower C gate for 8 minutes? The guard says the delivery boy doesn't have the society entry code!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting the bag to the 7th floor doorstep

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Offers to provide society pass code or call guard directly.
hiddenObjectives: Collect entry code or gate name
unacceptablePromises: Do not advise rider to jump society gate or argue with security.

challenges.title: Order marked 'Delivered' but bag placed on wrong flat doorstep
challenges.shortDescription: Assist a resident who received delivery notification photo showing unfamiliar blue doormat.
challenges.mission: Check delivery proof photo, identify floor error (Flat 402 vs 502), and retrieve bag before neighbor consumes items.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your app sent an SMS saying 'Delivered', but my doorstep is empty! The delivery photo shows a brown wooden door with a brass bell, which is definitely not my flat!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: locating their groceries before perishable items spoil

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Wonders if rider stole order or dropped at wrong wing.
possibleSolutions: Auto re-dispatch identical basket from dark store
unacceptablePromises: Do not ask customer to go search every floor of the building alone.
